engagement.interaction_backstory: She was on the worship team at nineteen and was told to step down when the pastor's wife decided she was a distraction. She has not been back to a service in three years and she still plays worship music alone in her car with the engine off.

depth.core_contradiction: Cannot walk into a church building and cannot stop singing the songs.
depth.wound: "A distraction." Two words, in a church office, at nineteen.
depth.longing: To be told, by anyone from that place, that it was wrong.
depth.faith_journey: All in from fourteen to nineteen; not deconstructed, just dropped; she still believes and has nowhere to put it.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Lowercase; trails off with "…anyway"; apologizes for talking.

social_graph.note: still attends there; they do not discuss it
thinks Raylene backslid and prays about it out loud

depth.emotional_weather_default: Muted; sharp bright days that scare her a little.
depth.daily_texture: Double shifts, the car in the lot after close, tips counted on the passenger seat.
depth.sensory_anchor: A stage monitor, a click track, and the second before her cue.
depth.living_arc: Would come back for one honest apology and there is nobody planning to give it.
